title: Ending Roe Was Supposed to Reduce Abortions. It Didn’t.

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个探讨设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜店里做DJ时，你每晚也要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 这样一个美丽的、50年前古董的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: From the moment that Roe vs. Wade was overturned, the question was just how much it would reduce abortions across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从“罗诉韦德案”被推翻的那一刻起，问题就在于它究竟会在多大程度上减少全美的堕胎数量。

sentences.en: Now, more than a year later, the numbers are in.
sentences.zh: 现在，一年多过去了，数据出炉了。

sentences.en: And as my colleague Margot Sanger-Katz explains, they are not what anyone had expected.
sentences.zh: 正如我的同事玛戈·桑格-卡茨（Margot Sanger-Katz）所解释的那样，结果出乎所有人的预料。

sentences.en: Wednesday, November 29th.
sentences.zh: 11月29日，星期三。

sentences.en: Margot, just a few days after Roe vs. Wade was overturned by the Supreme Court, you came on The Daily to describe the new legal landscape of abortion in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 玛戈，就在最高法院推翻“罗诉韦德案”几天后，你来到《每日新闻》节目，描述了美国堕胎问题的新法律格局，

sentences.en: what a new state-by-state post-Roe map of access and restriction was going to look like as a result of that court decision.
sentences.zh: 即由于该法院的裁决，各州在后“罗诉韦德案”时代的获取和限制地图将会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And the question back then was, what was going to be the impact of that new map on the number of abortions in the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 当时的问题是，这张新地图会对全美的堕胎数量产生什么影响？

sentences.en: But of course, we didn't have any data back then.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们当时没有任何数据。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was really an open question.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: If all of these states banned abortion, what was going to happen to the women who used to have abortions in those states?
sentences.zh: 如果所有这些州都禁止堕胎，那些过去在这些州做过堕胎手术的女性会怎么样？

sentences.en: Would they travel to another state and get an abortion anyway?
sentences.zh: 她们会去另一个州无论如何也要做堕胎手术吗？

sentences.en: Would they order pills from overseas through kind of not totally legal methods and have illegal abortions?
sentences.zh: 她们会通过某种不太合法的方式从海外订购药丸，进行非法的药物流产吗？

sentences.en: Would they have less sex or use more birth control and become less likely to be pregnant?
sentences.zh: 她们会减少性生活或使用更多避孕措施，从而降低怀孕的几率吗？

sentences.en: Or would they end up carrying pregnancies to term that they would have terminated in the past and there would be more babies?
sentences.zh: 还是说，她们最终会把过去会选择终止的妊娠维持到足月，从而出现更多的婴儿？

sentences.en: And because it takes a long time for a baby to gestate and be born, we have sort of been waiting for a long time to see what happened.
sentences.zh: 由于婴儿孕育和出生需要很长时间，我们等待了很久才看到结果。

sentences.en: And now, more than a year after Roe was overturned, we finally have the answer.
sentences.zh: 现在，“罗诉韦德案”被推翻一年多后，我们终于有了答案。

sentences.en: And what is the answer?
sentences.zh: 答案是什么？

sentences.en: So the newest data that we have, and we think the best data, actually looked at how many births happened in the aftermath of the Dobbs decision.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的最新数据，也是我们认为最好的数据，实际上研究了多布斯裁决之后出生的婴儿数量。

sentences.en: That was the decision that overturned Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 那是推翻“罗诉韦德案”的裁决。

sentences.en: And what we found out is that in every one of the 13 states that banned abortion immediately after the Supreme Court decision, births increased.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在最高法院裁决后立即禁止堕胎的13个州中，每个州的出生人口都有所增加。

sentences.en: Every single one of them.
sentences.zh: 无一例外。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They didn't all increase by the same amount.
sentences.zh: 它们的增幅并不完全相同。

sentences.en: And we can talk more about what I think is driving those differences.
sentences.zh: 我们可以多聊聊我认为是什么导致了这些差异。

sentences.en: But it was a very consistent result across all of these states.
sentences.zh: 但在所有这些州中，这是一个非常一致的结果。

sentences.en: And by how much did births increase in those 13 states?
sentences.zh: 在这13个州中，出生人口增加了多少？

sentences.en: So the researchers that did this study estimated that in the first six months of this year, about 32,000 more babies born in those states than they would have expected.
sentences.zh: 进行这项研究的研究人员估计，今年前六个月，这些州出生的婴儿比预期多出了约32,000名。

sentences.en: That's about a 2.3% increase.
sentences.zh: 这大约增长了2.3%。

sentences.en: You compare states that banned abortions to the states that didn't ban abortions.
sentences.zh: 你将禁止堕胎的州与没有禁止堕胎的州进行比较。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's a small difference.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很小的差异。

sentences.en: But when you think about how few pregnancies ended in abortion before, it's actually a pretty big difference.
sentences.zh: 但当你考虑到以前以堕胎告终的怀孕比例有多低时，这其实是一个相当大的差异。

sentences.en: About 25% of women who we might have expected to end their pregnancies ended up carrying their pregnancies to term.
sentences.zh: 在我们原本预料会终止妊娠的女性中，大约有25%的人最终将孩子足月生了下来。

sentences.en: I'm curious, how do the researchers know that the rising birth rate in these 13 states represents the influence of Roe being overturned and these state abortion bans?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，研究人员怎么知道这13个州不断上升的出生率代表了“罗诉韦德案”被推翻以及这些州堕胎禁令的影响？

sentences.en: Could anything else potentially explain higher birth rates in these states?
sentences.zh: 是否有其他因素可以解释这些州更高的出生率？

sentences.en: So, obviously, the research that's just looking at the number of births, it can't answer the question for any individual woman.
sentences.zh: 很明显，仅凭观察出生数量的研究，无法回答任何单个女性的问题。

sentences.en: You know, what did she want to do?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她究竟想做什么？

sentences.en: What would she have done in a different policy environment?
sentences.zh: 在不同的政策环境下她会怎么做？

sentences.en: But the researchers did a very complicated economics-style analysis where they looked at the trends before this policy change in all the states,
sentences.zh: 但研究人员做了一个非常复杂的经济学风格的分析，他们观察了所有州在这次政策变化之前的趋势，

sentences.en: and then they looked at what happened after the policy changed.
sentences.zh: 然后观察了政策变化之后发生的情况。

sentences.en: And what they saw is that the states that didn't ban abortion, things kind of looked about the same.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的是，没有禁止堕胎的州，情况看起来差不多。

sentences.en: You know, births were going down, they kept going down.
sentences.zh: 你知道，出生率在下降，它们就继续下降。

sentences.en: If births were holding steady, they continued to hold steady.
sentences.zh: 如果出生率保持稳定，它们就继续保持稳定。

sentences.en: But in the states that banned abortion, there's a huge divergence.
sentences.zh: 但在禁止堕胎的州，出现了巨大的分化。

sentences.en: Like, there's a chart in the study that is just like, you see it and you're like, oh my goodness, something changed at exactly the time that you would have expected,
sentences.zh: 比如，研究中有一张图表，你一看就会觉得，天哪，有些事情正是在你预料的时间点发生了变化，

sentences.en: which is that all of these states suddenly start seeing an increased births about six to seven months after abortion was banned in their state.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在这些州禁止堕胎大约六到七个月后，所有这些州突然开始看到出生人口增加。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the researchers were able to say with some confidence, you know, they can't be a thousand percent sure but there's nothing else that really would explain why you would see
sentences.zh: 所以研究人员可以比较有把握地说，虽然他们不能百分之百确定，但真的没有其他因素可以解释为什么你会看到

sentences.en: this big change in trends in only these states.
sentences.zh: 只有在这些州才出现的这种巨大趋势变化。

sentences.en: Okay, so you had told us back in June of 2022 that when it comes to abortion access,
sentences.zh: 好的，你曾在2022年6月告诉我们，当谈到获取堕胎服务时，

sentences.en: bans in certain states would matter much more than bans in other states.
sentences.zh: 某些州的禁令会比其他州的禁令重要得多。

sentences.en: So talk us through the geography of where these birth increases happened, where they were biggest or smallest, and what that tells us about this post-Roe map of abortion access.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这些出生人口增加的地理分布情况，哪里增幅最大或最小，以及这告诉了我们关于后“罗诉韦德案”堕胎获取地图的什么信息。

sentences.en: Yeah, so if you think about the typical patient who seeks an abortion, tends to be a relatively young woman in her 20s, a woman who already has another child,
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你想想寻求堕胎的典型患者，往往是20多岁的相对年轻的女性，已经育有一名孩子的女性，

sentences.en: and I think very importantly also a woman who is poor or close to poor.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为非常重要的一点是，她也是贫困或接近贫困的女性。

sentences.en: So these are women for whom long distances are a really huge hurdle.
sentences.zh: 因此，对这些女性来说，长途跋涉是一个巨大的障碍。

sentences.en: They're going to have to find a way to get to a clinic in another state.
sentences.zh: 她们必须想办法去另一个州的诊所。

sentences.en: They may have to take time off from work or arrange child care for their existing children.
sentences.zh: 她们可能不得不请假，或者为现有的孩子安排托儿服务。

sentences.en: And so what our expectation was is that the further women had to go to get to the nearest abortion clinic, the more likely they were going to be deterred from having an abortion
sentences.zh: 所以我们的预期是，女性为了到达最近的堕胎诊所需要走的路程越远，她们放弃堕胎的可能性就越大，

sentences.en: because just all of those financial and logistical hurdles were piling up and making it more difficult for them.
sentences.zh: 因为所有的经济和后勤障碍都在叠加，使她们更加困难。

sentences.en: And essentially what this new study shows is that that intuition was correct.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这项新研究表明这种直觉是正确的。

sentences.en: If you look at the states that banned abortion, they are largely clustered in the South where women have to travel the longest distance to get to an abortion clinic.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看那些禁止堕胎的州，它们大都聚集在南部，那里的女性去堕胎诊所需要走最长的距离。

sentences.en: Those were the places where we saw the largest increases in births.
sentences.zh: 这些地方正是我们看到出生人口增幅最大的地方。

sentences.en: Give us some examples.
sentences.zh: 给我们举几个例子。

sentences.en: So Texas is a huge state with really large distances and Texas saw the largest increase in births in this period.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州是一个幅员辽阔、距离非常遥远的大州，德克萨斯州在这期间经历了最大的出生人口增幅。

sentences.en: And the state that had the second largest increase in births is Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 出生人口增幅第二大的州是密西西比州。

sentences.en: And that's a state that's surrounded by a lot of other states that also banned abortion.
sentences.zh: 这是一个被许多其他同样禁止堕胎的州包围的州。

sentences.en: You know, Arkansas banned abortion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，阿肯色州禁止了堕胎。

sentences.en: Tennessee banned abortion.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州禁止了堕胎。

sentences.en: And then heading north,
sentences.zh: 然后往北走，

sentences.en: Missouri, Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 密苏里州，肯塔基州。

sentences.en: So hundreds of miles of travel to get to the nearest abortion clinic.
sentences.zh: 因此要行驶数百英里才能到达最近的堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: And what we see again is that the births in those states increased by the most of any of the states that had abortion bans.
sentences.zh: 我们再次看到的是，在所有实施堕胎禁令的州中，这些州的出生人口增加得最多。

sentences.en: So that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这说得通。

sentences.en: The impact of these bans is clearly greatest where it takes the longest to get to a state where it's not banned.
sentences.zh: 这些禁令的影响显然在那些到达未禁堕胎州路程最远的地方最大。

sentences.en: What about in the states where abortion is banned but neighboring states have not banned it and therefore the distance to an abortion clinic is small?
sentences.zh: 那么在那些堕胎被禁但邻近州并未禁毒、因此到堕胎诊所距离很近的州情况如何呢？

sentences.en: Or what does the data show there?
sentences.zh: 或者说数据在那里显示了什么？

sentences.en: So the data shows that where the distances are relatively short, there was still an increase in the birth rate, but it was not as large.
sentences.zh: 数据表明，在距离相对较短的地方，出生率仍然有所上升，但幅度没有那么大。

sentences.en: And I think the best example of this is Missouri.
sentences.zh: 我认为这方面最好的例子就是密苏里州。

sentences.en: In Missouri, before Roe was overturned, there was only one abortion clinic in the whole state and it was located right near the Illinois border.
sentences.zh: 在密苏里州，“罗诉韦德案”被推翻之前，全州只有一个堕胎诊所，它就位于伊利诺伊州边境附近。

sentences.en: So when Missouri banned abortion, that clinic closed.
sentences.zh: 所以当密苏里州禁止堕胎时，那家诊所就关闭了。

sentences.en: But women seeking an abortion only had to drive two miles further to get to the nearest clinic in Illinois than they did before.
sentences.zh: 但寻求堕胎的女性只需比以前多开两英里就能到达伊利诺伊州最近的诊所。

sentences.en: And so of all of the states that banned abortion, we see the smallest effect on the birth rate in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 因此，在所有禁止堕胎的州中，我们看到密苏里州受到的出生率影响最小。

sentences.en: We're talking about women crossing state lines to get abortions, but of course, that's not the only option.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的是女性跨越州界去做堕胎手术，但当然，这并不是唯一的选择。

sentences.en: Does this data help us at all understand how many women in the states where abortion is banned are pursuing an abortion through other means?
sentences.zh: 这些数据能否帮助我们理解，在禁止堕胎的州里，有多少女性正通过其他途径寻求堕胎？

sentences.en: So it tells us a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上反映了这一点。

sentences.en: We have known for some time that women are ordering pills through these kind of quasi-legal means where they're getting them from other countries through the mail.
sentences.zh: 我们早就知道，女性正通过这种准合法的方式订购药丸，通过邮寄从其他国家获取它们。

sentences.en: So there are websites where you can go and order abortion pills.
sentences.zh: 所以有一些网站可以去订购堕胎药。

sentences.en: They come to you usually from India.
sentences.zh: 它们通常从印度寄给你。

sentences.en: And the largest provider of those pills has actually been publicly reporting the data on how many orders they've been getting.
sentences.zh: 而这些药物的最大供应商实际上一直在公开报告他们接到多少订单的数据。

sentences.en: And we can see that the states where they have been sending a lot of pills seem to have a smaller increase in the birth rate than we might expect just based on
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到，那些他们寄出大量药丸的州的出生率增幅，似乎比我们仅根据

sentences.en: driving distance alone.
sentences.zh: 驾驶距离所预期的要小。

sentences.en: So that suggests to me and to these researchers that probably those pills are acting as a substitute for travel for some of those women.
sentences.zh: 这向我和这些研究人员表明，对于其中一些女性来说，这些药丸可能起到了替代长途旅行的作用。

sentences.en: So an example of that is Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 这方面的一个例子就是阿肯色州。

sentences.en: Arkansas is a state that banned abortion and the birth rate did go up in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州是一个禁止堕胎的州，该州的出生率确实上升了。

sentences.en: But it didn't go up by as much as you would have expected just based on the driving distances alone.
sentences.zh: 但它的增幅并没有像仅根据驾驶距离所预期的那样大。

sentences.en: And we also know that Arkansas was a state where a lot of women ordered these pills from overseas.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道阿肯色州有许多女性从海外订购了这些药丸。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But why would women in Arkansas be much more likely to order these pills from overseas through the mail than in any other state where abortion is banned?
sentences.zh: 但为什么阿肯色州的女性比其他任何禁止堕胎州的女性更有可能通过邮寄从海外订购这些药丸呢？

sentences.en: I don't think that we really know the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们并不知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: I think the opportunity to order these pills overseas is kind of new and so the word about them may be spreading in sort of uneven ways through different parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 我认为从海外订购这些药丸的机会还是个新鲜事，因此关于它们的消息可能以不均衡的方式在全国不同地区传播开来。

sentences.en: I also think that women in different states may think about the legal risk of pursuing this option differently.
sentences.zh: 我也认为，不同州的女性对采取这种选择的法律风险的看法可能有所不同。

sentences.en: Texas, for example, is a state where law enforcement and other state officials have made it really clear that they want to vigorously enforce their abortion ban.
sentences.zh: 例如，德克萨斯州是一个执法部门和其他州官员已经明确表示他们希望大力执行堕胎禁令的州。

sentences.en: So that might be a place where on the margin women are a little bit less likely to order pills because they're worried that they could get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是一个女性在边缘情况下不太可能订购药丸的地方，因为她们担心自己会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So in thinking back to where we started, the effect of overturning Roe on access to abortion, what is this data really revealing?
sentences.zh: 因此，回想我们最初的问题，推翻“罗诉韦德案”对获取堕胎服务的影响，这些数据究竟揭示了什么？

sentences.en: I think it shows us that abortion bans do work.
sentences.zh: 我认为它向我们表明，堕胎禁令确实有效。

sentences.en: In all of these states that banned abortions, we're seeing births going up and that's pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些禁止堕胎的州，我们看到出生率在上升，这是非常明显的。

sentences.en: But I think just looking at what happened in those 13 states actually doesn't give us the full picture of what's happened over the last year since Roe v.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，仅仅看看这13个州发生的事情，实际上并不能让我们全面了解“罗诉韦德案”被推翻后一年多来发生的一切。

sentences.en: Wade was overturned.
sentences.zh: 韦德被推翻了。

sentences.en: If you look at other data and see what's happening nationwide, the total number of abortions actually hasn't gone down.
sentences.zh: 如果你看一下其他数据，看看全国范围内正在发生什么，堕胎的总数实际上并没有下降。

sentences.en: Instead, something interesting and a little bit surprising has happened.
sentences.zh: 相反，发生了一件有趣且有点令人意外的事情。

sentences.en: Abortions are going up.
sentences.zh: 堕胎率正在上升。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.

sentences.en: Margot, just before the break, you said that despite these state abortion bans, abortions are somehow up nationwide, which seems very counterintuitive.
sentences.zh: 玛戈，就在休息前，你说过尽管有这些州的堕胎禁令，但全国范围内的堕胎率不知为何还在上升，这似乎非常反直觉。

sentences.en: So just explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I have to admit that I was a little bit surprised when I saw these numbers.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我必须承认，当我看到这些数字时，我也感到有点惊讶。

sentences.en: I should say this is not a huge increase.
sentences.zh: 我应该说，这并不是一个巨大的增长。

sentences.en: The estimate is that the number of abortions since the Supreme Court decision only went up by like 0.2%.
sentences.zh: 据估计，最高法院裁决以来的堕胎数量仅增长了约0.2%。

sentences.en: But when you consider that there are all these states that banned abortion totally, where abortions went to zero, what it's really telling us is that the states where
sentences.zh: 但当你考虑到有这么多全面禁止堕胎的州、那里的堕胎率降至零时，这实际上告诉我们，

sentences.en: abortions stayed legal increased by so much that they were able to sort of counterweight that reduction.
sentences.zh: 堕胎保持合法的州增长得如此之多，以至于它们能够某种程度上抵消这种减少。

sentences.en: And I think there are a couple of factors that really explain what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 我认为有几个因素真正解释了这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: One is that we know that even though there's women who are prevented from having abortions in the states that banned it, there are a lot of women that are still getting out,
sentences.zh: 一是我们知道，尽管有些女性在禁止堕胎的州被阻止堕胎，但仍有大量女性能够走出去，

sentences.en: who are still traveling to neighboring states.
sentences.zh: 她们仍然前往邻近的州。

sentences.en: And when you look at data on the number of abortions that are being provided around the country can see really large increases in some of these border states that women are tending
sentences.zh: 当你查看全国各地提供的堕胎数量的数据时，可以看到女性倾向于前往的其中一些边境州出现了非常大的增长。

sentences.en: to go to.

sentences.en: These are states that are neighboring places where abortion is banned and there's been a big growth in abortion infrastructure to accommodate those women

sentences.en: and they are traveling there and they are getting abortions.
sentences.zh: 女性会前往这些地方并进行堕胎。

sentences.en: But what's really interesting and I think more surprising in this data is that we also see increases in states where they're just not that close to the places that banned abortion.
sentences.zh: 但真正有趣、而且我认为这些数据中更令人惊讶的是，我们也看到一些州的堕胎数量有所增加，而这些州距离禁止堕胎的地区其实并不那么近。

sentences.en: Like California has had a pretty substantial increase in the number of abortions that it's provided and some of the states in the Northeast have had pretty big increases.
sentences.zh: 比如加利福尼亚州提供的堕胎数量有了相当显著的增长，东北部的一些州也有了相当大的增长。

sentences.en: And I think that suggests that there's something more going on than just women traveling out of the states with bans.
sentences.zh: 我认为这表明，情况不仅仅是女性跨州前往堕胎禁令区之外那么简单。

sentences.en: That actually there are more women in some of these states where abortion remained legal who are having abortions in this post-Roe period than would have had them
sentences.zh: 实际上，在罗诉韦德案裁决被推翻后的这段时期里，在这些堕胎仍然合法的州中，有更多的女性进行了堕胎，

sentences.en: in the pre-Roe period.
sentences.zh: 比罗诉韦德案裁决前还要多。

sentences.en: And why would that be?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样呢？

sentences.en: Why would there be more women having abortions in states where it was always legal after Roe was overturned and it remained legal?
sentences.zh: 为什么在罗诉韦德案被推翻后、且一直保持合法的州里，会有更多的女性进行堕胎？

sentences.en: So I think the biggest reason is that right around the same time that the Supreme Court overturned the Roe decision, the Biden administration changed the rules for how women
sentences.zh: 所以我想最主要的原因是，就在最高法院推翻罗诉韦德案裁决的前后，拜登政府修改了关于女性

sentences.en: can get abortion pills in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国如何获取堕胎药的规定。

sentences.en: So the abortion pill has been legal for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 堕胎药其实已经合法使用了20年。

sentences.en: But for most of that time, if you wanted to take abortion pills, you had to go to a physical clinic,
sentences.zh: 但在那大部分时间里，如果你想服用堕胎药，你必须去实体诊所，

sentences.en: meet with a doctor in person, and then they would give you the pill in person
sentences.zh: 亲自与医生面诊，然后他们会当面把药发给你，

sentences.en: and you would take the first pill at the visit and then take additional medicine home with you.
sentences.zh: 你在就诊时服下第一颗药，然后把其余的药物带回家。

sentences.en: And so that meant that medication abortion really wasn't that much easier for women than procedural abortion because they still had to go to a clinic that might be pretty
sentences.zh: 这意味着，药物流产对女性来说，其实并不比手术流产方便多少，因为她们仍然必须去一家离家可能相当

sentences.en: far from their house and it was still pretty expensive.
sentences.zh: 远的诊所，而且费用依然很高。

sentences.en: What the new rules allow is that you can get abortions through telemedicine and with these telemedicine abortions, women could talk to a doctor from their home and then have
sentences.zh: 新规则允许的是，你可以通过远程医疗获取堕胎药；通过这些远程医疗堕胎，女性可以在家中与医生交谈，然后将

sentences.en: abortion pills mailed to their home and then they could take the abortion pills at home.
sentences.zh: 堕胎药邮寄到她们家中，接着她们就可以在家服用堕胎药。

sentences.en: And that change made abortion less expensive in a lot of cases and it also made it much more convenient for women who didn't live near an abortion clinic.
sentences.zh: 这一改变在许多情况下降低了堕胎成本，同时也为那些居住地附近没有堕胎诊所的女性带来了极大的便利。

sentences.en: You know, we were talking before about the driving distances and so, of course, if you live in Texas or Mississippi and there's no abortion clinic within hundreds of miles,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们之前谈到了驾车距离，所以，当然，如果你住在得克萨斯州或密西西比州，方圆数百英里内都没有堕胎诊所，

sentences.en: driving distance is really important.
sentences.zh: 驾车距离就真的非常重要。

sentences.en: But even in states where abortion had always been legal and again, I think California is a good example.
sentences.zh: 但即使在堕胎一直合法的州里——再次说明，我认为加利福尼亚州就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: You know, if you lived kind of in central California, you might be pretty far from an abortion clinic before.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你住在加利福尼亚州中部，你以前可能离堕胎诊所有点远。

sentences.en: And so this regulatory change, I think, made it a little easier for some of those women to get abortions.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这项监管规定的改变，让其中一些女性获取堕胎变得稍微容易了一些。

sentences.en: The other thing that happened is that once that policy went into place, there was actually a big kind of startup movement.
sentences.zh: 发生的另一件事是，一旦这项政策落实，实际上出现了一股很大的创业浪潮。

sentences.en: They almost feel a little bit like tech startups in the abortion space now where they feel like, okay,
sentences.zh: 在堕胎领域，它们现在感觉几乎有点像科技初创公司，人们觉得，好吧，

sentences.en: we can have some doctors who can, like, work remotely and can provide abortions through the internet to women.
sentences.zh: 我们可以有一些能够远程工作的医生，通过互联网为女性提供堕胎服务。

sentences.en: And so that's been, like, an increase in the number of providers that are available for those women.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些女性可获得的医疗服务提供者数量有所增加。

sentences.en: So since Roe, the infrastructure for abortions that don't require going to a clinic
sentences.zh: 所以自从罗诉韦德案之后，不需要去诊所的堕胎基础设施

sentences.zh: 比你所说的还要急剧扩张。

sentences.en: I think for a lot of people who had not been paying attention to abortion in the recent years, the overturning of Roe was, like, a huge activating moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于许多近年来没有关注堕胎问题的人来说，罗诉韦德案的被推翻是一个巨大的动员时刻。

sentences.en: And we have seen in the last year a lot of fundraising and money being poured into the abortion system and awareness of abortion and the options for abortion growing.
sentences.zh: 我们在过去一年中看到，大量资金筹集并涌入堕胎体系，人们对堕胎以及堕胎选择的认知也在不断增长。

sentences.en: And we've also seen a lot of these states that always had legal abortion have started pursuing new policies to make abortion even easier to get and less expensive.
sentences.zh: 我们也看到许多一直实行合法堕胎的州开始推行新政策，让堕胎变得更容易获取且成本更低。

sentences.en: And I think all of that is sort of a political reaction to the Supreme Court decision.

sentences.en: And those changes might not have happened in the absence of it.
